words.note: 最直接、較中性的改寫，表示某人沒有記住原本應該記得的資訊、日期、名字或事情。
words.example: I failed to remember his new phone number.
words.exampleZh: 我沒能記住他的新電話號碼。

exercises.original: She forgot the date of the appointment even though she had written it down.
exercises.zh: 即使她已把預約日期寫下來，她還是忘記了。
exercises.upgrade: failed to remember · 忘記；未能記起

options.explanation: failed to remember = 未能記起。the date of the appointment 是一項應記住的資訊，這裡純粹描述記憶失敗。
overlooked = 忽略；漏看。較常表示沒有注意到某細節，不是單純記不起日期。
left behind = 遺留。通常指把實體物件留在某地。
neglected = 疏忽；沒有去做。重點是沒有履行責任，而不是記憶本身。
lost track of = 失去掌握。常用於時間、數量、進度或某人的去向，不直接等於忘記一個日期。
ignored = 忽視。表示知道但選擇不理會，和無意忘記不同。

exercises.original: I forgot his surname for a moment during the introduction.
exercises.zh: 介紹時，我一時忘記了他的姓氏。
exercises.upgrade: failed to remember · 忘記；未能記起

options.explanation: overlooked = 漏看；忽略。surname 不是被漏看，而是當下想不起來。
failed to remember = 未能記起。for a moment 明確表示短暫記不起一項已知資訊。
neglected = 疏忽。通常需要一項應完成但未完成的責任。
left behind = 遺留。不能用於姓氏這類資訊。
lost track of = 失去掌握。通常不用來表示一時想不起姓氏。
dismissed = 不理會；駁回。表示主動拒絕，而不是記不起來。

exercises.original: He forgot the password he had created only the day before.
exercises.zh: 他忘記了自己前一天才設定的密碼。
exercises.upgrade: failed to remember · 忘記；未能記起

options.explanation: failed to remember = 忘記。password 是需要從記憶中取回的資訊，最直接。
overlooked = 忽略。若他看到密碼提示卻沒注意才合適。
neglected = 疏忽。不是沒有履行責任。
misplaced = 放錯地方。只能用於實體物件，不能表示忘記密碼。
left behind = 遺留。也是實體物件用法。
ignored = 忽視。表示知道而不理會，不是忘記。

words.note: 當 forget 指沒有注意到一個細節、項目或步驟，因此漏掉了它，可用 overlook。這和純粹『想不起來』不同。
words.example: We overlooked one important detail in the report.
words.exampleZh: 我們漏掉了報告中的一個重要細節。

exercises.original: The editor forgot one spelling error while checking the final page.
exercises.zh: 編輯檢查最後一頁時漏掉了一個拼寫錯誤。
exercises.upgrade: overlooked · 忽略；漏掉；沒注意到

options.explanation: overlooked = 漏掉；沒注意到。while checking the page 表示錯誤就在眼前，但編輯沒有察覺。
failed to remember = 未能記起。拼寫錯誤不是要從記憶中回想的資訊。
left behind = 遺留。通常指實體物件。
lost track of = 失去掌握。不是檢查文件時漏看一個細節。
neglected = 疏忽。可表示沒有做某事，但這句更精確是漏看一個 error。
blanked on = 一時想不起。通常接名字、答案等記憶內容。

exercises.original: We forgot a small but important clause when reviewing the contract.
exercises.zh: 我們審閱合約時漏看了一條雖小但重要的條款。
exercises.upgrade: overlooked · 忽略；漏掉；沒注意到

options.explanation: neglected = 疏忽。可能指沒有處理條款，但 reviewing the contract 更直接是漏看。
overlooked = 漏掉。small but important clause 是典型容易在審閱中被 overlooked 的細節。
failed to remember = 未能記起。不是記憶問題，而是審閱時沒注意到。
left behind = 遺留。不能用於條款。
lost track of = 失去掌握。通常指進度、時間或數量。
dismissed = 不理會。表示有意覺得不重要，和無意漏掉不同。

exercises.original: The accountant forgot one invoice in the stack and did not include it in the total.
exercises.zh: 會計師漏掉了文件堆中的一張發票，因此沒有把它計入總額。
exercises.upgrade: overlooked · 忽略；漏掉；沒注意到

options.explanation: overlooked = 漏掉。invoice in the stack + did not include it 明確表示檢查時沒有注意到。
blanked on = 一時想不起。不是從記憶中搜尋資訊。
failed to remember = 忘記。這裡發票實際在文件堆中，問題是漏看而非記憶。
left behind = 遺留。不是把發票留在某地。
ignored deliberately = 故意忽略。題目沒有故意不計的線索。
lost track of = 失去掌握。較適合時間、數量或進度。

words.note: 當 forget 指因事情太多或時間太久而失去對時間、數量、進度、某人的去向等的掌握，可用 lose track of。
words.example: I lost track of time while reading.

exercises.original: I forgot the time while working and suddenly realized it was midnight.
exercises.zh: 我工作時忘了時間，突然才發現已經午夜。
exercises.upgrade: lost track of · 忘了；失去掌握；搞不清

options.explanation: lost track of = 忘了／失去掌握。lost track of time 是固定搭配，表示忙於某事而沒有察覺時間流逝。
failed to remember = 未能記起。較像忘記某個時間點或日期，不如 lose track of time 自然。
overlooked = 忽略。不能自然說 overlooked the time 來表示沉浸工作。
left behind = 遺留。不是實體物件。
neglected = 疏忽。不是沒有履行某責任。
blanked on = 一時想不起。通常指名字、答案等。

exercises.original: With so many people joining the project, I forgot who was responsible for which task.
exercises.zh: 加入項目的人太多，我開始搞不清誰負責哪項工作。
exercises.upgrade: lost track of · 忘了；失去掌握；搞不清

options.explanation: overlooked = 漏掉。這不是漏看單一細節，而是整體責任分配變得難以掌握。
lost track of = 失去掌握。with so many people 是決定性線索，表示資訊太多而搞不清分工。
failed to remember = 未能記起。雖然可理解，但沒有『逐漸失去掌握』的意味。
left behind = 遺留。無關。
neglected = 疏忽。不是沒有做應做的工作。
ignored = 忽視。表示明知而不理，不是搞不清。

exercises.original: She forgot how many books she had already counted and had to start again.
exercises.zh: 她忘了自己已經數了多少本書，只好重新開始。
exercises.upgrade: lost track of · 忘了；失去掌握；搞不清

options.explanation: lost track of = 搞不清。how many... counted 是典型失去數量進度掌握的語境。
overlooked = 漏掉。不是漏看某一本書，而是失去計數進度。
failed to remember = 忘記。較一般，沒有持續計數中失去掌握的意味。
neglected = 疏忽。不是沒有履行責任。
left behind = 遺留。無關。
blanked on = 一時想不起。通常是突然無法回想固定資訊，而不是計數進度。

words.note: 當 forget 指沒有做一件本應做的事情，尤其帶責任或疏忽意味時，可用 neglect。語氣比單純 forget 更強。
words.example: He neglected to renew the licence before it expired.
words.exampleZh: 他疏忽了在牌照到期前續期。

exercises.original: He forgot to submit the form before the deadline despite several reminders.
exercises.zh: 儘管收到多次提醒，他仍忘了在截止日期前提交表格。
exercises.upgrade: neglected · 忘了做；疏忽；未有處理

options.explanation: neglected = 疏忽；未有做。despite several reminders + deadline 表示這是本應完成但沒有完成的責任。
overlooked = 漏掉。可以漏看表格，但句子核心是沒有提交。
lost track of = 失去掌握。若忘了 deadline 可以說 lost track of time，但不是替代 submit 動作。
left behind = 遺留。只適合物件。
blanked on = 一時想不起。不是責任疏忽。
failed to recognize = 未能辨認。無關。

exercises.original: She forgot to lock the office door when she left.
exercises.zh: 她離開時忘了鎖辦公室門。
exercises.upgrade: neglected · 忘了做；疏忽；未有處理

options.explanation: failed to remember = 未能記起。可描述原因，但句子更直接是在說本應完成的安全動作沒有做。
neglected = 疏忽。neglect to do something 很適合忘記履行責任。
overlooked = 漏掉。通常接 detail/item，不如 neglect to lock 自然。
lost track of = 失去掌握。無關。
left behind = 遺留。不是把門遺下。
ignored deliberately = 故意忽視。題目沒有故意不鎖門。

exercises.original: The team forgot to update the emergency contact list for several months.
exercises.zh: 團隊數月來一直疏忽更新緊急聯絡人名單。
exercises.upgrade: neglected · 忘了做；疏忽；未有處理

options.explanation: neglected = 疏忽。for several months 表示一項應定期處理的責任長期未完成。
overlooked = 漏掉。可指某次漏看，但數月沒有更新更像 neglect。
blanked on = 一時想不起。通常是短暫記憶失靈。
left behind = 遺留。不是實體遺失。
misplaced = 放錯地方。無關。
lost track of = 失去掌握。可以 lost track of when it was last updated，但不直接等於沒有更新。

words.note: 當 forget 表示離開某地時忘記帶走實體物件，可用 leave behind。
words.example: I left my umbrella behind at the restaurant.

exercises.original: I forgot my umbrella at the café and had to go back for it.
exercises.zh: 我把雨傘忘在咖啡店，只好回去拿。
exercises.upgrade: left behind · 遺留；忘記帶走

options.explanation: left behind = 遺留。umbrella at the café + had to go back 表示離開時把實體物件留在原地。
overlooked = 漏看。不是在檢查中漏掉雨傘這個細節。
neglected = 疏忽。可泛指疏忽，但不如 leave behind 精確表示物件遺留。
lost track of = 失去掌握。通常不是指把物件留在某地。
failed to remember = 未能記起。可以描述腦中忘記，但不直接表達物件被留在咖啡店。
blanked on = 一時想不起。不能接實體物件。

exercises.original: She forgot her notebook in the meeting room after everyone left.
exercises.zh: 大家離開後，她把筆記簿忘在會議室。
exercises.upgrade: left behind · 遺留；忘記帶走

options.explanation: misplaced = 放錯地方。表示把物件放到不記得的位置，但題目已清楚知道 notebook 在 meeting room。
left behind = 遺留。after everyone left + in the meeting room 明確是離開時忘記帶走。
overlooked = 漏掉。不是文件審閱中的細節。
neglected = 疏忽。太一般。
lost track of = 失去掌握。可指不知道物件在哪，但這裡位置清楚。
forgot about = 忘了某事／不再想到。不能精確表達物件被遺留。

exercises.original: They forgot one suitcase at the hotel when they drove to the airport.
exercises.zh: 他們開車去機場時，把一個行李箱忘在酒店。
exercises.upgrade: left behind · 遺留；忘記帶走

options.explanation: left behind = 忘記帶走。suitcase + at the hotel + drove away 是典型物件遺留語境。
overlooked = 漏掉。可以說 overlooked a suitcase while checking luggage，但不如 leave behind 表達結果。
neglected = 疏忽。沒有直接表達行李仍留在酒店。
blanked on = 一時想不起。不能接 suitcase。
lost track of = 搞不清去向。題目已知道 suitcase 在酒店。
ignored = 忽略。暗示知道但不理會。

words.note: 常見口語片語，表示某事本來應記得，但一時沒有想到。常見結構是 It slipped my mind。
words.example: I'm sorry—the meeting completely slipped my mind.
words.exampleZh: 對不起，我完全忘了那個會議。

exercises.original: I forgot about the meeting completely until she called me.
exercises.zh: 直到她打電話給我，我才發現自己完全忘了會議。
exercises.upgrade: it slipped my mind · 一時忘記；完全沒想起

options.explanation: it slipped my mind = 我一時完全忘記。until she called me 表示原本應記得，但事情完全沒有進入當下意識。
I overlooked it = 我漏掉了它。較像看文件或處理事項時沒有注意到，不如 slipped my mind 口語自然。
I left it behind = 我把它遺下。只適合實體物件。
I tracked it poorly = 我追蹤得不好。不是自然的忘記事項表達。
I neglected it deliberately = 我故意不理。題目沒有故意成分。
I misplaced it = 我放錯地方。meeting 不是實體物件。

exercises.original: Her birthday slipped out of my memory until I saw the reminder.
exercises.zh: 直到看到提醒，我才想起她的生日；之前完全忘了。
exercises.upgrade: it slipped my mind · 一時忘記；完全沒想起

options.explanation: I lost track of it = 我失去掌握。通常用於時間、進度或去向，對 birthday 不如 slipped my mind 自然。
it slipped my mind = 我一時忘記。seeing the reminder 才重新想起，是這個片語的典型情境。

options.text: I overlooked it on the page
options.explanation: I overlooked it on the page = 我在頁面上漏看。題目沒有頁面閱讀語境。
I left it behind = 遺留。生日不是物件。
I neglected it deliberately = 故意不理。與無意忘記相反。
I misplaced it = 放錯地方。生日不能 misplaced。

exercises.original: I was supposed to call him, but I forgot completely while dealing with other problems.
exercises.zh: 我本來應該打電話給他，但處理其他問題時完全忘了。
exercises.upgrade: it slipped my mind · 一時忘記；完全沒想起

options.explanation: it slipped my mind = 我完全忘了。while dealing with other problems 表示注意力被其他事情佔據，原本應做的事一時沒想起。
I left it behind = 遺留。電話不是實體物件。
I overlooked a typo = 漏看拼寫錯誤。語義完全不同。

options.text: I lost track of him physically
options.explanation: I lost track of him physically = 搞不清他的去向。不是忘記打電話。
I ignored him on purpose = 故意忽視。題目說的是忘記，不是有意不聯絡。
I misplaced the call = 把電話放錯地方。不是自然英文。

words.meaning: 突然想不起；腦袋一片空白
words.note: 較口語，表示某一刻突然想不起原本知道的名字、答案、詞語或資訊，常帶臨場緊張或短暫失憶感。
words.example: I blanked on her name during the presentation.
words.exampleZh: 我在簡報時突然想不起她的名字。

exercises.original: During the interview, I forgot the name of the software I use every day.
exercises.zh: 面試期間，我突然想不起自己每天都用的軟件名稱。
exercises.upgrade: blanked on · 突然想不起；腦袋一片空白

options.explanation: blanked on = 突然想不起。during the interview + something I use every day 表示臨場突然腦袋空白，而不是從未記住。
overlooked = 漏掉。不是看文件時沒注意到。
left behind = 遺留。不能用於名稱資訊。
neglected = 疏忽。不是沒有做責任。
lost track of = 失去掌握。通常不表示突然想不起一個名字。
ignored = 忽視。表示知道但不理會。

exercises.original: She forgot the answer for a few seconds even though she had studied it the night before.
exercises.zh: 即使她前一晚已溫習過，她仍有幾秒突然想不起答案。
exercises.upgrade: blanked on · 突然想不起；腦袋一片空白

options.explanation: failed to remember = 未能記起。意思可通，但 for a few seconds + had studied it 明確是短暫腦袋空白，blanked on 更自然。
blanked on = 突然想不起。短暫、臨場、原本知道答案是典型語境。
overlooked = 漏掉。不是視覺檢查錯誤。
left behind = 遺留。答案不是實體物件。
neglected = 疏忽。不是責任問題。
lost track of = 失去掌握。通常不是單一答案瞬間想不起。

exercises.original: He forgot his colleague's name just as he was about to introduce her.
exercises.zh: 正要介紹同事時，他突然想不起她的名字。
exercises.upgrade: blanked on · 突然想不起；腦袋一片空白

options.explanation: blanked on = 突然想不起。just as he was about to introduce her 表示臨場瞬間失憶。
neglected = 疏忽。不是忘了履行責任。
overlooked = 漏掉。不是檢查內容時忽略名字。
left behind = 遺留。名字不是實體物件。
ignored = 忽略。表示有意不理會。
lost track of = 失去掌握。不能自然表示瞬間想不起名字。

words.note: 當 forget 表示有意不再想着某件不愉快、已結束或不重要的事時，可用 put out of one's mind。這和無意記不起不同。
words.example: She tried to put the argument out of her mind.
words.exampleZh: 她試着把那次爭吵拋諸腦後。

exercises.original: After the exam, he tried to forget his mistakes and focus on the next subject.
exercises.zh: 考試後，他試着把自己的錯誤拋諸腦後，專心準備下一科。
exercises.upgrade: put them out of his mind · 把……拋諸腦後；不再去想
exercises.answer: put them out of his mind

options.text: put them out of his mind
options.explanation: put them out of his mind = 把它們拋諸腦後。tried to + focus on the next subject 表示有意停止反覆想着已發生的錯誤。
overlook them = 忽略它們。較像沒有注意到錯誤，不是事後有意不再去想。
leave them behind physically = 實體遺留。mistakes 不是物件。
blank on them = 突然想不起。這是無意記憶失靈，不是主動放下。
lose track of them = 失去掌握。不是情緒上放下。
neglect them = 疏忽。不是有意停止思考。

exercises.original: She wanted to forget the embarrassing moment and enjoy the rest of the evening.
exercises.zh: 她想把那個尷尬時刻拋諸腦後，好好享受餘下的晚上。
exercises.upgrade: put it out of her mind · 把……拋諸腦後；不再去想
exercises.answer: put it out of her mind

options.explanation: overlook it = 忽略。較像一開始沒注意到，而不是已發生後主動不再想。

options.text: put it out of her mind
options.explanation: put it out of her mind = 把它拋諸腦後。wanted to... enjoy the rest of the evening 明確表示主動停止想着尷尬經歷。
blank on it = 一時想不起。不是有意行為。
leave it behind = 留下。可比喻說 leave the past behind，但此題最精確是 mentally put it out of her mind。
lose track of it = 失去掌握。不是情緒處理。
neglect it = 疏忽。無關。

exercises.original: The coach told the player to forget the missed shot and concentrate on the next play.
exercises.zh: 教練叫球員把投失的一球拋諸腦後，專心下一個回合。
exercises.upgrade: put it out of his mind · 把……拋諸腦後；不再去想
exercises.answer: put it out of his mind

options.text: put it out of his mind
options.explanation: put it out of his mind = 把它拋諸腦後。concentrate on the next play 表示主動停止回想上一個失誤。
overlook it = 忽略。可能指不追究，但沒有明確的心理放下意味。
blank on it = 突然想不起。不能由教練命令自己短暫失憶。
leave the ball behind = 把球留在後面。字面意思錯誤。
lose track of it = 搞不清。不是主動忘掉。
neglect it = 疏忽。無關。

falseSynonyms.zh: 忽視；不理會不等於一般的 forget ignore = 忽視；不理會 ignore 通常表示知道某事存在，但有意不理它；forget 則通常是無意沒有記住或想起。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You may remember a warning and still ignore it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 放錯地方；一時找不到不等於一般的 forget misplace = 放錯地方；一時找不到 misplace 表示把實體物件放到一個不記得的位置。你可能因忘記放在哪而 misplace something，但它不是一般 forget 的同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You forget where the keys are; you may have misplaced the keys.

falseSynonyms.zh: 遺失不等於一般的 forget lose = 遺失 lose 表示物件真的不再在你掌握中。forget something somewhere 可能造成遺留，但不等於永久遺失。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can leave a bag behind without losing it permanently.

falseSynonyms.zh: 記得不等於一般的 forget remember = 記得 remember 是能夠保留或取回記憶，和 forget 意思相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON If you remember the date, you have not forgotten it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 提醒不等於一般的 forget remind = 提醒 remind 是使某人重新想起某事，通常是對抗 forget，而不是 forget 的近義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A reminder helps you avoid forgetting.

falseSynonyms.zh: 原諒不等於一般的 forget forgive = 原諒 forgive 是停止責怪某人或不再怨恨。雖然 'forgive and forget' 常一起出現，但兩者意思不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can forgive someone without forgetting what happened.

falseSynonyms.zh: 健忘的不等於一般的 forget forgetful = 健忘的 forgetful 是形容詞，形容一個人容易忘記事情；forget 是動詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He is forgetful. He often forgets appointments.

falseSynonyms.zh: 被忘記的；已遺忘的不等於一般的 forget forgotten = 被忘記的；已遺忘的 forgotten 是 forget 的過去分詞或形容詞，不能在所有位置直接替代動詞 forget。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The password was forgotten. He forgot the password.
